title: DogDesk
description: GNOME × Undertale: the small white dog from your own copy of Undertale lives on your GNOME desktop. It trots along your window tops, naps when you're away, notices notifications, sometimes absorbs a window you close, eats the treats you give it, and keeps out of your way (never over fullscreen apps, and it dodges drags). Its sprites and music are read from your Undertale install; nothing from the game is included.

launch.message: The dog is on your desktop. The first time, log out and back in so GNOME loads it.

notes.firstLaunch: Needs GNOME Shell 47 or newer. Log out and back in after installing or updating. Click the dog to pet it, double-click for walkies, drag it to pick it up. The Dog tile in Quick Settings has treats, call it over, sounds and more.
